content.rendered:
I don’t remember any pranks that i pulled. Just when i was younger, i tried to say somethings to my mother, but off course she knew that i was lying.
When i remember that is april folls, and try to to pull a prank on someone, i just start laughing and the person knows that i’m lying.

Once, my brother pulled a prank on me, saying that he was going to travel with my parents and i couldn’t go with them. I was a kid, and started crying, imaginig that my parents would leave me alone. Then, when my mother listened, she tolds me that was just a joke and she would never do this.

This year, 2014, in April Fool’s day pranks who prank me was my dating in Brazil. At morning I was talking with her by Whatsapp and she told me “ wow Andre, today is April Fool`s day…. I will do a prank with you today, ahahah“ and I said, “ no away Bianca, now I already know about your prank, I will remember that all day, and I will know when you try it“.
However, the day was passing, passing and, of course, in the end of the day I had no idea about she would try pranks me today. When I arrived in my room the first thing that she told me was “ I have a thing to talk with you“, immediately I began to thought about everything that I could, she is pregnant, someone die or she crashed her car. Thanks god was nothing serious was just one more April Fool`s day pranks. So, she began to say “ Andre, when you come back to natal I will be living in Rio de Janeiro, my father get transferred to Rio de Janeiro and I`m going to live there next month, today I started looking for College to transfer my University from Natal to Rio de Janeiro. In the first moment I was terrified, I couldn`t think, I couldn`t move, nothing. After five minutes totally quiet I said her, “it will be good for your career, you will have much more possibilities to get a good job and I coming back I`m going to do a connection in Rio de Janeiro you can see me on airport“, I said that but I was very sad writing that. When I would ask to her stay in natal and finish the College there she said me “ happy april fool`s day“. Five minutes more I had declared myself to her, however thanks god that it didn’t happened.

Happy April fool`s day for everybody

Once my boyfriend pulled a prank on me.
By that time I didn’t knew his uncle and didn’t knew he was a cabby, so they decided to pick me up to my boyfriend’s house using the yellow car, just pretending Rapha (my boyfriend) was by cab.
We were on our way to his house and the “cabby” just started talking to us like he was our “friend” and telling that he was going to go to Rapha’s house too, to enjoy the barbecue was going on there. Than, I got jolted, because Rapha just allowed the cabby goes to our barbecue .. I felt afraid of the situation and they just started laughing and making fun of me! It was April 1st and I didn’t notice that …
The amount of pregnancy posts on Facebook blew me away.

We had played prank on teacher Lemy in April 1st.
One of my classmates went to the Lemy’s class and showed memo which was written “Please add to this student in your class by Alfred”.
After that, we did same things until every class moved to his class.

At first, he believed, but he found out it is prank after over three students came to his class.
Finally, last my class mate showed the memo to him, “happy April fool”

content.rendered:
What are LuLu’s favorite idioms? Anything related to cats, of course! Below you will find some common cat related idioms and their definitions.

*remember, to practice, I encourage you to write a comment below using the new idioms in context. Write a story, a sentence, anything to utilize them. Or, introduce your own cat related idiom to help others!*

  1. curiosity killed the cat : (expression) used as a way to say that being too curious can get you into trouble, or as a warning to someone who is trying to get too involved in someone else’s business.                                                example: Paulo is planning something special for Jennifer’s birthday, and she knows that something is going on when he quickly ends a phone call about an airline ticket. After asking a few questions about what he was doing, Paulo tells Jennifer, “Stop asking so many questions! Remember, curiosity killed the cat!”
  2. to let the cat out of the bag: (verb) to make a secret known public                              example: Holly’s birthday was around the corner and Jennifer was planning a surprise party at her favorite restaurant. However, Christopher let the cat out of the bag when he accidentally told her about the dinner.
  3. a cat nap: (noun) a short sleep (nap) taken during the day.                          example: After working all day, Krystal needed a cat nap before her work party to feel awake and refreshed. 
  4. look what the cat dragged in: (expression) used to greet or acknowledge someone that you are surprised to see, similar to: “Look who’s here!”      example: While at a favorite happy hour spot, Jered and Parker are surprised to see their old roommate, Kerry, walk into the same bar and say hello, “Well, well, look what the cat dragged in! How are you?”

Happy Studying! ♥

content.rendered: Awesome article.

Hello! I just would like to offer you a huge thumbs up for
the great info you have here on this post. I’ll be returning to your website for more soon.
Thank you!
Very easy to understand!
Yes, breeleelee.. I love that, too!

One of my favorite kitty-related idiom for LuLu: “Cat got your tongue?”
I love when someone is speechless or too surprised to speak that I can smile and say: ‘What’s the matter, cat got your tongue?’
I take cat naps almost every day at work in my car.
Awesome! Love the theme idea! Your students are so lucky to have such an amazing teacher 🙂 <3

<meta property="og:description" content="Okay. You’ve got the grammar textbooks, dictionaries, and translators. In the classroom, you are a superstar. So why is it so difficult to sometimes understand what natives are saying in the “real world?” What is the difference between being an English language learner who sounds like a learner, and one who sounds more like a native? The answer to both of those questions: IDIOMS. According to Merriam-Webster Learner’s Dictionary (the best ESL dictionary, ever!) an idiom is: 1 : an expression that cannot be understood from the meanings of its separate words but that has a separate meaning of its own.  2 : a form of a language that is spoken in a particular area and that uses some of its own words, grammar, and pronunciations.  3 : a style or form of expression that is characteristic of a particular person, type of art, etc. [count] In other words, it’s language that’s difficult to learn in a book, with no context, extremely useful and common in any English speaking country, and most importantly, a way to express YOU. So, how should you learn? As there are thousands (and thousands) of idioms out there, I recommend learning them by common theme. The great thing is that idioms can be categorized in so many ways. Find something that interests you, and do a search: _____(interest) idioms and voilà, there you have it. Or, leave it to me. Learn English idioms online with English Outside the Box. In the comment section of each new weekly post, I encourage you to write a relevant story where you can try and use these new idioms, because without application, the learning process can be very difficult.  Happy learning! <3 *to comment, click the comment bubble to the right of the post's title.*" />

content.rendered: It is the story about Sergio Garcia who immigrated illegally at 17 months old. Even though it was not his idea to immigrate, but he is the person who is illegally stay in the USA. As you know, people who illegally get into other countries sometimes might be dangerous. They don’t have their ID, so government or police can’t catch them even though they are criminal.

The government in the US shouldn’t have given permission Sergio Garcia who immigrated illegally at 17months old. He couldn’t realize what he did at that time, but he should have realized what he’s done when he became older. Unfortunately, he kept staying illegally. I can’t get it why he is accepted, even if we know that he isn’t dangerous because he’s been here illegally. The US should kick him out. There are many people who try to immigrate illegally and they brings drugs , crime and something like that.

It is the story about Sergio Garcia Who is in America illegally. He graduated from law school. Can he is allowed Practice law? In my opinion, he can practice law. Because it makes more illegal immigrant. I heard It has been problem for a long time in America. In my country, There are also a lot of illegal immigrant. Most of them usually make a lot of trouble. They commit crimes. Absolutely He is a good evidence all of them don’t make a problem. But If He is permitted to practice law, It will be a problem.
That is the reason why I disagree He is forbidden to practice law.

Even though I feel some sympathy for this unfortunate young man, I think he should not be able to go to the bar as an attorney in the United States. Because, his status in America is not even legal. Furthermore I definitely believe that it does sound ridiculous if an illegal figure teaches or insists public not to commit unlawful crimes.

For this story/video to give an opinion, is not easy!
When I heard the story about Sergio Garcia 36years old, and that he lives since he is a teenager in the USA and he steel didn’t get a green card, I feel sad for him! Because they are many other People in the USA with the same history like Sergio!
I can`t understand why the Government said 20 years No to the green card! In my opinion is Sergio a good Student and he become a Lawyer, and to get this, he had to study very hard and he doesn’t look like an criminal guy. I mean he went to school he had many years a typical American live, so why not!
The Government had to give a very hard decision, because it`s not just Sergio, all the other People without a green card, will say, why does he get one and we don’t!
Finally it`s very hard to say, who can have a green card and who does not.

I’m enraptured.

It is a fact that he immigrated illegally, and it is a crime. He should pay off his sin. However, I think we should not judge someone by his past. Past is only past. California government should leave the fault of past in the past, and just judge him as who he is. He have already graduated Cal northern school of law. Therefore, my advice for government is ‘Punish the former fault that he immigrated illegally’ and ‘Don’t interrupt what he do now’.

I have a mistake.

“They ought to think about how we can give a green card to Sergio ASAP illegally.”

illegally -> legally

Sorry.

The video and article show that one man who is in US illegally, name is Sergio Garcia, receive admission to a state bar association. And it is very controversial because federal law says undocumented immigrants are denied professional licenses. But California governor, Jerry Brown, allow Sergio to get licenses. So now California becomes the first state to allow an illegal immigrant to get licenses.
I think this controversy is very interesting thing. Because Sergio case is kind of breaking the law. And now federal law is still prohibiting immigrants to get professional licenses. In my opinion, Sergio case is very good thing but it break the law. Law is very important things to maintain our society. If many exceptions occur in the law, I think law loses the power and also very hard to maintain society.
So I think California government had better not allow Sergio to practice law right now. They have a time and discuss how Sergio can practice law legally as soon as possible. Up to 2019 is too late. So if California government wants to give a chance to practice law to Sergio, They ought to think about how we can give a green card to Sergio ASAP illegally. Once Sergio has a green card, He practices the law legally.

For this controversy I choose neutral.I think he can be allowed topractice law, although he didn’t have a green card and identity.But he had already graduated from university of law, he has the ability to survive.Like he said “absolutely no law that says that I can’t create my own job and open my own company”.He isn’t a dangerous person and he won become the burden of the United States.so why not？

The must social media I used is instegram because it makes me contact with my friends and it makes me meet new people even though I agree with that average. i

I agree this result . Usually ,I don`t use cell phone a lots. Our life so close to technology . we use technology at everytime everywhere but sometime that is not good for us. If we addicted technology we won`t care about our real life. we are not only find convenient but also we don`t try to something
we don`t have to try to do something cuz Technology do instead of us. so that reson why we don`t addicted technology. we have to live our own life.Technology can`t live our life instead of us

My result is 38%. I agree that I’m addicted to technology,However I disagree with the test result because I only use laptop and my cell phone. I use my cell phone for 2 to 1 hour. But i use my laptop more than 10 hours. I think my result should be less than 38%.

my name is Jaden.I think i’m not a special addiction.My result test is 41%.i think the score is right for me. i prefer to oudoos than technology.But i cant quit using my phone. But sometime i need to use some technology product to help me how i can do something.I think technology is a good assistant if you use it moderately.

My result is 41% addicted to technology. I don’t agree with my result.
I’m addicted to technology a little. If I don’t use any technology, it doesn’t matter to me. just grumpy! Technolongy is surely useful to our lives but we shouldn’t abuse technology.

My name is Lee juyon.
My result is 61%. It is average score. So i just think i am addicted to technology as others are. And it is not a problem because we live in high-technology era, so have to know how to use, and need to use phone or internet to communicate with others. If nobody use technology, I can live without the machines. But everybody use technology, so I have to use.

my name is Nawaf

First of all my result of the test shows that I’m 63% addicted to technology.
i disagree with that, i think the percentage should be more were i can’t live with out my phone. i can live with out a laptop or an ipad day or two but my phone i can’t live with out it for one hour. i think technology has become an imoprtant part of life.

title.rendered: Using Quotes to Practice and Improve English

content.rendered:
“The value of a man resides in what he gives and not in what he is capable of receiving.”

-Albert Einstein

Not only are quotes inspirational and motivational, they can also be a great learning tool. Quotes can help you expand your vocabulary, show you grammar structures, and can give you practice with expressing your opinion. This last thing is perhaps my favorite! Many of you, and all of my students want to improve speaking skills, and a huge part of this English fluency is knowing how to express your opinion on a variety of topics.

So this post, and the quote above will be your English lesson this week. Let’s review how you can use quotes to practice and improve English.

Expand Vocabulary

  • Use the quote to define new words.
    • For example: reside [verb] exist or be present, to live at a particular place
  • Use those words to learn synonyms
    • For example: reside → consist, lie, occupy, remain
  • Use those new words (from the quote and your synonym review) to make new sentence examples

Grammar Structures

Notice the following grammatical patterns and structures:

  • articles: definite article “the” and indefinite article “a”
    • we use THE when a noun is specific. In this case, we see “the value of a man”, we are talking about a particular value. Therefore, we need the definite article THE
    • we use A when a noun is nonspecific or in the first time it’s mentioned. In this case, we see “a man”, and this man in nonspecific (we don’t know who it is) and it’s the first time we’ve mentioned him. So we need the indefinite article A
  • preposition + gerund: when a preposition is followed by a verb it must be the gerund
    • capable OF RECEIVING

Expressing your Opinion

Practice your writing or you speaking (if you record yourself) by expressing your opinion. To practice, answer the following questions:

  1. What does this quote mean? (imagine explaining it to a child)
  2. Does this quote inspire or motivate you in any way? If yes, how?
  3. Do you agree with this quote, why or why not?
  4. Think about a personal experience that this quote relates to and talk about that experience

There are 3 ways you can use quotes to improve English. I look forward to hearing your responses, so please share your opinions in the comments below!

Happy Studying! ♥

If you want more English with me, join the Conversation Club – a monthly fluency training program with weekly lessons to help your vocabulary, reading, listening, and pronunciation + 6 group calls to practice speaking and to connect with an English teacher and other learners. Sign up for the 1-week free trial by clicking here or get more information below.

content.rendered: You can understand that phrase, if you are able to read between the line, because what Einstein want to tell us is that: is not important how much you are able to understand or what you feel during the receiving phase, because if you aren’t ready to gives You’ll never understand really the meaning of receiving.

I completely agree with quote. I have some examples. We were in charity center yesterday, and I really like that. Based on my feelings, I thought that it’s really good action. I mean, when someone want rescue homeless children. This woman amazing person, I’m sure she really happy in her soul, because if you doing smth good and open your soul for strangers for sure you have big reason for woke up in the morning.

I agree about this quote. I was absent yesterday. But I know why It is good for your personal feeling. Because I’ve been to volunteer work center that is try to help disabled person. I helped them like wash body, bring to park. And that people are so kindful. My feeling is too fulfilled and I got many thing even studing something.

The value of a man
The value of a man of what he gives in what he gives and not what he is capable to receive.

First ,as I concerned the real man which he can give more than what he has taken. For kids women and homeless.

Finally, as my opinion most of the greatest men in the world who gives their sacrifice to the humanity such as imam HUSSAIN and NELSON MANDELA.

In my opinion, this quote is almost right in person’s life. If you want to donate something to charity, maybe you don’t expext that something is gonna return to you.
for example, when you give something to charity or help poor people, do you expext something compensation? probably not!

Of course wrong!! The real value of a man, (and not women because they have only one good thin that everybody knows) is possible to notice through his money, his cars & his women. Nobody cares about what he gives to the other people. Could be charity, help or something else, but hes real value is based on his power. More you are a shark, more pover you get.

Obviously I don’t think every bullshits I said…

The value of a man resides in what he gives and not in what he is capable of receiving. I agree with this sentence. We cant grade the value of a man but we know that a man who always gives something have more value than others. Altough something is not money, there are many things you can give like a warm mind or kindness. Receiving person is selfish. If you receive something, you should give something for poor person. That’s a charity. Actually i dont have much money but i like to volunteer for poor person. I can give my knowledge and mind. I think its very important in our life.

I agree with this quote, because you just can be a better person if you can put yourself in the place of the other people, and make something to help them. You can give them your time, your love and material staffs.
The visit of yesterday remaind me my job in Brazil, and I think this kind of charity is so similar in all over the world, is a good job that can help many people to be better and believe on themselfs when nobody more believe. If which person do a little thing to make the world better, we can change the things that we don’t like and make it a better place to live.

title.rendered: Out in the Real World: Practical Language Learning

content.rendered: Hi all! Tell me about some of your recent activities out in the real world. Have you tried something new? Some things you can try: movies (English with English <or NO> subtitles), reading a local newspaper or magazine, taking a local tour, visiting museums (Balboa Park has tons!), listening to some local radio stations or downloading an interesting podcast… I want to hear it! 🙂 Happy Studying!

content.rendered:
Reblogged this on Learn English Online | English Outside the Box and commented:

I dropped the ball (wasn’t prepared) for #givingTuesday this year. There are no excuses though, I’ll start by spreading the word. Knowledge is power, and together we can definitely make a positive impact on the world!

What are you going to do to give back today?

I think it is a good idea to arrange special days to remind people of being kind to each other. For example, there is a special day to make moms happy – Mother’s Day. Giving Tuesday is a charity day. As for me, it is a pleasure to do something good for the people I really want to make happy, because I am sincere about it. On the contrary, when I was doing the task to speak with strangers about Giving Tuesday and give them candies, it was difficult to communicate with passers-by. Most people were tense, strained or busy. And this is not bad, I understand them. For me, it means that they are okay, they just don’t want any violation of their privacy. They don’t need any help or support right now or they are not ready to accept it from a stranger. Some days ago I was riding a bicycle, and a had a flat tyre. I was along in the darkness far away from my place with a broken bicycle, so I went to a nearest parking to find a pump. Some guy understood the situation, put my stuff in his car and drove me home. He told me that he was just taking care of his karma. =) Such helpfulness of people inspires me to continue this line of goodness. My conclusion is that one should make happy the people they really want to or somebody who really needs their compassion now. In this case a Giving Tuesday is just an occasion to remind yourself: “Hey, dude, don’t forget to improve the world around you”! And if you have postponed it until today, do it right now!

Hi everybody! I was in the street today giving back free hugs to the people it wasn’t so effective but at least i give some candys to the people on the street and told they about givingtuesday the people also smile me and it was a really good experience I enjoy this kinds of activities because I think I feel better than the people who smile when I feel that I making a little bit moré happy to someone.

My givingtuesday.
Today, I met two men on the street with my partner and we gave candies to them. When we gave the candies, we explained the meaning of givingtuesday.
When they heard the meaning they looked so happy.
After coming back to my home, I sent text mail to my friends who live in Korea. I gave good meaning of words and listened their saying.
I will try to do this more and more.
Happy givingtuesday!!

Hi,today I went with my partner to the street and we gave chocolate and also flowers and coffe,I realized that small actions can be big thing for someone else and can change their day.After the school my friend want to joing the givingTuesday and we paid lunch for two homeless,was an amazing experience and made me more happy!

The happiest moment in my life is when I give something for another one for the purpose of drawing a smile on his or her face. Today, I got a lot of happy moments when I wandered out in the streets with two of my friends, gave candy and smiles to people and made conversations with them about this special day which called Giving Tuesday. It was a nice experience which I hope to do it again and again. Let’s make all of our days Giving Tuesdays!

Hello everyone! Today, I went to the street with my partner in order to give back smiles, free hugs, comprimentos and chocolate. Also, I gave chocolate for some teachers and I said thank you for helping me to improve my English. That was a great experience because I could realize that simple actions can change the day of people, including my day. So, I recommend everyone give something back today.
Until the next post!

I went to a parking lot with Alex. Alex always parks his car in this place. So Alex wants to give something a staff. We bought a cup of coffee, and gave to her. She was smiling.
I think giving to other people makes me happy. I want to give to people who I like something before going back to the Korea.

title.rendered: Which quote is meaningful to you during this special week?

content.rendered:
1) “Be thankful for what you have; you’ll end up having more. If you concentrate on what you don’t have, you will never, ever have enough.” -Oprah Winfrey
2) “As we express our gratitude, we must never forget that the highest appreciation is not to utter words, but to live by them.” -J. F. Kennedy
3) “Not what we say about our blessings, but how we use them, is the true measure of our thanksgiving.” – W.T. Purkiser

content.rendered:
Reblogged this on Learn English Online | English Outside the Box and commented:

It’s a great day to show our appreciation, to reflect on what we are thankful for, and a time to express this gratefulness to others. If you are celebrating Thanksgiving today, happy day to you!

1) “Be thankful for what you have; you’ll end up having more. If you concentrate on what you don’t have, you will never, ever have enough.” -Oprah Winfrey

I also strongly agree to this quotation and actually it is my motto. there are four things that I always try to remember. Be thankful, be positive, be satisfied, and don’t compare with others. I am a person who believes that happiness is up to myself. Whenever I feel bad, I remember those things. And then I can overcome that situation. Do you remember our past topic “Eating”? At the first class, we discussed about “Eat to live, not live to eat”, and I think it can be the same on this case. The reason why we have something is just for maintain our life, we can’t live for having the best things. Now my laptop doesn’t work well, because I spilled water on my laptop. I can’t use the k on the keyboard. So every time I want to use k, I should copy and paste. It really drives me crazy, but I am thankful for it still works. I know practically it is hard to be thankful for everything. However, you guys try to be thankful for all of you!

1) “Be thankful for what you have; you’ll end up having more. If you concentrate on what you don’t have, you will never, ever have enough.” -Oprah Winfrey

I’m totally agree which this statment. Then on earth it gives so a lot of people who have nothing, who have all days to fight for survive. A lot of people want every time more, a better car, a bigger house, a higher salary ect. also I wish me that sometimes, but we should be thankful for what we have. When I sometimes see pictures from poor countries around the world I say me: ” Damn, I have a really good life!” and when I think about that I feel sometimes sorry about all this poor people. On the other hand, I’m really happy about what I have all in my life. All people should one time ask about what they care in their life. So that’s the reason why I like this statement.

1) “Be thankful for what you have; you’ll end up having more. If you concentrate on what you don’t have, you will never, ever have enough.” -Oprah Winfrey

I really like the meaning of this quote because I think that the people should be always thankful with the things that they have, I mean if you aren’t enought happy with the things that you have you wouldn’t be happy never, the material things have only to be another instrument to make your life easier, but the objetive in your life have to be happy and makes happiest the people who are around you, for me becomes more importan one simple smile in the street than hundred of dollars.

content.rendered:
Actually, on this weekend I didn’t go out anywhere. However, we have a big holiday next week! So I want to plan about next week.
I think party is a good chance to practice our English skills. It has many advantages. Firstly, we are able to practice our listening and speaking skills, there are many foreign students in parties, so we can practice understanding different accents. And also can use English in real world. Second, we can boost our confidence. In my case when I talk to others, I worry about my grammatical mistakes. So when people don’t get what I mean, I easily lose my confidence. However when I talk with someone whose mother language isn’t English, I can get rid of my worry. So try joining party!
If parties are not your cup of tea, you can eat out with your roommates or classmates instead.

Usually I spend my weekend going outside and watching drama. Saturday, I always go out and talk with everyone whom I meet. Sunday, I take a rest to relieve myself but I watch a drama like ‘Game of thrones’ or ‘Friends’. Actually it has a Korean subtitle, but I keep try listening. Recently, I started watching ‘Modern family’ without caption. I can’t understand everything but I review again and again until I can understand.
I’m not sure that watching with a subtitle is helpful for me but, I believe it helps me to improve my English!

Hi! Everybody I also have a plan to improve my english during this weekend concretly today it is sunday and I will prepare a spanish dinner to my host family and the neighbors I will make a Paella I hope they enjoy it and have a good time and conversation after the dinner. If they dont like it at least I will know how a real native explain me why he or she dosent like it.

Have a hice end of weekend!!

Hey everyone! I have a plan to improve my English during this weekend. On Saturday, I will go out with my roommate and her friends and this will help me to improve my English because they are all from Switzerland. Also, it’s easy to learn when you have fun. On Sunday, if the weather is good, I will go to the beach with some friend. But if the weather isn’t good, I will go to the mall in order to practice my English.
Until next post!

content.rendered: One of the many things i’ve learned with my partner about this country is how to drive around. She thought me how to merge, change lanes and yield. Also to be very careful with pedestrians, since they almost always have the right of way. In my country we honk to say thanks, here….. not so much. As passengers we can also drink alcohol inside cars, here is strictly prohibit.

Gianna is such as a wonderful girl from Korea, Seoul. She lives in huge, fabulous place in the world, so she would like interduos her city. Seoul has four seasons. Her culture is very respect people and bow as greating people. Food is quit spicy. They have big wedding. Traditional close don’t wear now. She misses her country, but she prefer work hard for her future and stay in the US.

Hey everyone! Today I learned many things about Italy with my friend Virginia. She told me that depending on which part is in Italy, Brazilian will be very well received. Also, I learned with her that is really common in Italy try to negotiate at some stores, especially if you are a woman.
Until next post!

I learning about Korean who they leave they use a subway to school or work but in rash hours they use car because it hard to drive .
Also if I Vista to friend house it is not necessary to bring gift

Brasil is wonderful country where the music and dancing is really popular specially during the most famous festival: the carnival! The carnival takes place between February and March.The carnival in Rio de Janeiro, Bruna’s city, is the biggest and the most beautiful! There is also a competition diuring the carnival and people work hard during the whole year to win it!!

Saudi Arabia.
I talked with Lora and she told me that most Saudi Arabian has religion just how much they care about their religion is different. And at there a woman can’t drive but nowadays women try to change the raw so they do their best.
Go to busan can find the most delicious seafood dishes . The fry chicken in Korea is real nice to try . The fruit in Korea is not inexpensive.

I would like to go to China.
I like eating out, so I will go to ‘night street market’. We can eat various foods and the cost is cheap($10~20). I think we could eat athentic chinese food in there.
The market is held to 9p.m to 2 a.m.
In addition, chinese accomodation is cheap. Therefore I could travel china longer as possible as I can.

However, I’d better not to buy clothing and bags in china.
It’s is really pricey.
I find out that the biggest stadium in South Korea has a capacity of around 50000. The stadium is in Seoul and the play soccer inside. So if the nationalteam of Korea plays it is there.

I asked to Alex about Soufiarabia.

I was surprised that I can’t sake hands with women.

He told it looks so weird.

But I can sake hands with men even I meet him first time.

After my question, he asked about subway. After answering, I asked same question.

He told Soudi’s subway(actually likes torlley) dangerous.

So he recommended if I want to go somewhere, I should buy or rent a car.

I think handsaking taboo is most impressive for me.

content.rendered: According to me that’s the best way to learn any language still if you shifted from your native country to abroad just to learn other language well some people can’t afford to do that much changes in life. Well its not even obvious the duration that in this time period you will learn everything. Without joining any coaching classes or any learning classes you will learn only from the environment and you don’t about any language so you can’t question to anyone that you’re going on right path or wrong. Well my native language is not English so please correct me if i am wrong 🙂 . Thanks English Out of the Box

Hi~ I think you are really enjoy your life in San Diego! In my opinion, without a doubt, finding something new is important, and you have been doing it well. I want to know how do you keep your positive mind, because recently I have some mixed feelings, I can’t figure it out and it makes me depressed. Please advise to me what should I do ?

Hi guys! I am sure that living abroad gives us the best environment to learn other languages. And that is why I came here! Actually, before I came here, I didn’t worry about anything except myself. I really worried about myself. Because I already have experienced to live abroad, And I found the thing that is more important than an environment.
At the very beginning of my China life, I even didn’t know how to say hello in Chinese. There is no doubt that I had a conversation problem. In addition, everything in China is different with Korea. It was pretty hard to adapt to a new environment. After few months, I could feel comfortable. However, comfort brought
laziness. I almost stayed at my dormitory. I studied Chinese with books at home. It made me get higher score in the exams, but not in real life! People who usually went out were more good at speaking.
Good environment is already surrounding us. If we look around more often, we could get more real English! We shouldn’t be homebodies, instead of that, we should do many activities. Let’s use this great opportunity!

Hi guys, i just think that any kind of experience abroad should be the best oportunity ever to grow up in the way of living. Don’t be shy and lazy, try to meet as much people as you can. I did the same and I didn’t feel anykind of miss feelings. I’m a little bit scared about the reverse shock, but it doesn’t matter. i suggest you guys to visit all the california county, rent a car and travel as much as you can. if you have enough time try to reach Monument Valley, is a very amzing canyon 16 hours far in the east, it should be in the border between utah and arizona.
Bye have fun

oh yes! I totaly agree with you! I had the same feelings reading previous comments! )) It’s a real paradise on the Earth! )) Absolutely hedonistic life! Sun, ocean, amazing sunsets on the beach, freedom, relaxed people, kayaks, boat parties… Come on! Isn’t it a dream life? ))

Hey David! I totally agree with you, living abroad is a great opportunitty and can also be really hard. First of all, you should open your mind for everything that you will see and don’t forget to respect the differences. Second, you should make new friends becuse they will become really important for you and they will help you to figure out your homesickness. The last one, but no less important, you should go out and have fun. Bye

I’m sorry to hear that.

Surgery in a foreign country is hard because you might feel lonely all the time.

But if you overcame this hard time, you can do everything!

And I think you already overcame this problem and you can do everything!

Trust yourself!

You will be the person who you want to be!

I would like to give some comments.
I think you already overcame your difficulties in America.
However, if you want more enjoy living in America, you should make foreign friends more and more.
Why don’t you participate in Kaplan activity such as writing thanks giving cards, eating out sweet cake and so on?

The more you make your foreign friends the more you can enjoy your life in America.

I wish you have fun in San Diego!

Hey, I can imagine how you felt when you arrived. The most important thing is, like you said, to make new contacts. If you have all the time a lot of people around you, you will miss your family less, then if you are all the times alone.

You are English is really good but you should check your writing when you finish it. You always miss the ‘ when you type can’t. Everyone go a abroad will get homesick . You will fell better after several mouthes later. Enjoy your new life in the US .
